steps.title: Transfer samples to prep plates
steps.instruction: Using the p300 multi‑channel or single‑channel pipette, transfer up to 57 samples from Eppendorf tubes arranged in 24 tube racks into 96‑well sample preparation plates in duplicate as shown in the attached Excel layout.

steps.title: Add standards and make dilutions
steps.instruction: Transfer IgG, IgM, and IgE standards into the same sample preparation plate and perform the required serial dilutions according to the arrangement provided in the Excel spreadsheet.

steps.title: Distribute to ELISA plates
steps.instruction: Using the p300 pipette, transfer the duplicated samples and the serially diluted IgG, IgM, and IgE standards from the 96‑well preparation plate to three 384‑well ELISA plates, following the plate layout indicated in the attached spreadsheet.
